exposure: Middle Eastern or North African (MENA) origin
outcome: short-stay neonatal intensive care unit admission
cohort: The study included 809,172 infants born to pregnant women in Quebec, Canada, between 2008 and 2020.
finding: The MENA group had an elevated risk of gestational diabetes, postterm birth, and short-stay neonatal intensive care unit admission, but a lower likelihood of preterm birth, severe neonatal morbidity, preeclampsia, or severe maternal morbidity compared to the non-MENA group.
